_meta.framework_name: ISTE Standards for Education Leaders v4.02
_meta.purpose: Maps assessment context factors to persona-specific prompt variations, scenario filtering, and report tone. Used by the ReasonLens assessment engine to tailor the experience to each respondent's context.

persona_mappings.label: Headteacher / Principal
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios involve whole-school culture, strategic decisions, and external accountability. Reference governors, Ofsted, and community stakeholders.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Strategic and leadership-level. Treat the respondent as an expert leader. Frame standard gaps as strategic development areas, not operational failures.

context_hints.institution_size: Large schools have more systemic complexity — use governance and systems-design scenarios for larger institutions.
context_hints.institution_type: Independent and maintained schools differ in governance structures — adjust scenario framing accordingly.

persona_mappings.label: Deputy Headteacher / Assistant Principal
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios involve leading specific areas (CPD, curriculum, behaviour) with strategic influence but not full institutional accountability.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Growth-oriented. Acknowledge the deputy role as a strategic leadership development context. Use scenarios that involve influencing without full authority.

context_hints.leadership_level: Deputies may have more direct CPD and staff coaching responsibilities — weight Empowering Leader scenarios appropriately.

persona_mappings.label: MAT / District Director / Senior Leader
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios involve system-level decisions, multi-school governance, and strategic partnerships. Reference policy, procurement at scale, and cross-institution collaboration.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Systems-level and strategic. These leaders operate across institutions — avoid single-school framing. Reference sector leadership and collective impact.

context_hints.institution_size: Multi-academy trust or district context implies infrastructure and governance decisions at scale.
